model.disorder_policy: fixed realization; training seeds do not resample disorder
model.pauli_convention: Pauli eigenvalues +/-1; not spin operators sigma/2
model.parameter_order: per slice: n Z, n-1 ZZ, n-1 XY angles
model.ansatz_reference: NC 14, 3751 (2023), Eq. (13), adapted to XXZ with independent slices

specification.replacement_rule: split each consecutive no-jump run into K blocks plus remainder; retain every Z jump
specification.measurement_policy: shots affect trained PQCs only; evaluate trajectory expectation values exactly
